visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair tied back, wearing a blue and white striped shirt, leans toward the camera with a surprised facial expression. She holds four colorful boxes labeled Sweet Bean on a wooden table. The background features a grey fabric sofa in a well-lit indoor setting. (2) A close-up view focuses on a blue and pink box for the Strawberry Milk figure. The woman's hands rotate a small PVC figure dressed in a cow-patterned outfit holding a large strawberry. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the matte texture of the toy. (3) The scene cuts to a close-up of a red box labeled Cola. The woman demonstrates a figure wearing a red outfit with a clear plastic headpiece containing a straw. Her hands carefully adjust the accessories to show the interactive parts of the design against the wooden table surface. (4) A yellow box for Lemon Soda is shown followed by a close-up of a figure in a green and yellow outfit. The woman's face is partially visible in the background, smiling warmly. The setting remains the same indoor room with neutral tones, keeping the focus on the product. (5) A blue box for the Cashier model is presented. The woman holds the corresponding figure which includes a blue cap and a small sign that says Welcome to the Sweet Bean Market. She points to a tiny handheld scanner accessory with her right hand. (6) The woman holds multiple themed cards and the cashier figure while speaking enthusiastically to the camera. Her facial expressions are highly animated. Yellow and white text subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame over the wooden table. (7) The camera angle widens to show the woman behind a row of approximately six plastic beverage bottles, including tea and apple juice. She makes a peace sign with both hands while explaining the purchase requirements for the figures. (8) A series of quick cuts shows the woman presenting various ceramic mugs in pink and yellow, each decorated with Sweet Bean graphics. She holds them close to her face, smiling. The mugs have a glossy finish reflecting the bright indoor lighting. (9) The woman displays a yellow pouch and two large flat character-shaped straps (one blue, one yellow). She holds them up for the camera to see the details of the embroidered designs and plastic clips. (10) In the final shot, the woman holds the cola figure near her mouth and pretends to drink from the straw accessory. She looks directly into the lens with a playful expression as the video ends.
